full_manuscript_numerator: Whole source manuscript length is the intended numerator for the accepted principal results. It is not an assertion that all auxiliary or historical statements have been replaced.
qualifications: L066: the reversal-orbit argument repairs the source Lemma 3.3 proof; Remark 3.4 is endpoint reversal, not unconditional self-duality. Theorem 4.4 remains in its regular-polyhedron context. Ordinary ambient automorphism results are retained, degree-six fusion is computed.

L074: all odd N>1 principal counting, generation, rank, intersection and duality conclusions are covered, with exact equality to the nested source formula. The classical Suzuki/Lüneburg structure, maximal subgroups and finite-field inputs remain attributed. Source Lemma 2 arbitrary-field Bruhat and Lemma 3 general ovoid plane sections are not completely reproved; Lemma 4 torus coprimality is unused.

L104: complete 8/19/3/no-higher census under the exact stated geometric axioms and full equivalence; TomLib subgroup catalogue and exact GAP operations are retained. Printed diagrams, complete Aut/Cor groups, doubling relation and supplement annotations are excluded.
No L073/M22 extension or extra L085 source credit is included.
formal_scope: Eight new extension/action declarations and two reused involution-centralizer declarations; no end-to-end formal source census, field geometry, normalization or completeness of external catalogue. Later support-count formal work is separate.
